text:
Elena (CEO): quick finance AH Q — short run-through: burn, procurement guardrails, and any follow-ups. drop questions here, @Jon will take. :wave:

Jon (CFO): current snapshot — ~22 months of runway at current burn. target is to get to 18-20 months by end of Q3 via hiring pacing and cost ops. will share slides.

Priya (Finance Ops): procurement update: new approval matrix live today. TL;DR: <=$5k manager; $5k-$50k manager + finance; >$50k procurement + legal + exec. exceptions require Gov ticket.

Sam (Eng): for Dedicated capacity requests (GPUs), who signs off for the buffer we sometimes need for on-call spikes?

Priya (Finance Ops): Sam (Eng) — file a procurement ticket and set category=dedicated-capacity. include estimated peak QPS + cost delta. Manager + EngDirector sign, finance reviews. sample body:
```
Project: realtime-cache
Category: dedicated-capacity
Estimate: 4 x A100 reserved + 2 x burst
Justification: 99p latency target; expected +20% traffic Jan->Mar
Cost Estimate: $X/month
Approvals: Eng Director, Manager
```

Ivy (Platform): who owns the burst budget vs. committed budget? e.g., if we autoscale, which cost center is billed?

Jon (CFO): committed capacity charged to team cost center; burst (pay-as-you-go) falls to central infra budget for first 90 days, then it's reallocated to the owning team if sustained. For emergency spikes we auto-approve up to $5k/day with alerting.

Nina (Product): if revenue dips, what's the hiring freeze trigger? any thresholds for immediate action?

Jon (CFO): contingency plan: 10% YoY downside -> hiring pause on non-critical roles; 20% downside -> company-wide hiring freeze + 30-day runway re-eval. We'll codify triggers in the runbooks.

Gabe (Legal): on-prem contracts often need FO/PO early. Do we have a checklist to avoid delays?

Priya (Finance Ops): yes — procurement checklist: PO template, SOW, security review stamp, and export control signoff (if applicable). Attachments required on ticket.

ah-bot: note: added Q&A thread to AH notes doc — https://redwood.app/docs/all-hands/finance-qna-1803459999

Elena (CEO): awesome, thanks all. Priya/Jon — please post the quick checklist and the slides in #announcements and tag @eng-leads. closing this thread, follow-ups in doc. :rocket:
